<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">GPT-5.6 Terra is the mid-tier model in OpenAI&#x27;s GPT-5.6 family. It sits between Sol and Luna on intelligence and price, making it a strong pick for everyday agentic coding when you want more capability than Luna without Sol&#x27;s cost.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="strengths"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#strengths" data-heading-base-id="strengths" aria-label="Copy link to strengths"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Strengths</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Solid multi-step coding and tool use at well under Sol&#x27;s per-token price.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Faster and cheaper than Sol for routine agent workflows.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Same GPT-5.6 family behavior: reasoning, tool calling, and agent loops.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="limitations"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#limitations" data-heading-base-id="limitations" aria-label="Copy link to limitations"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Limitations</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Not the peak of the GPT-5.6 family. For the hardest long-running tasks, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/models/gpt-5-6-sol">GPT-5.6 Sol</a> is the stronger pick.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Less capacity for open-ended reasoning chains than Sol.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="tools"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#tools" data-heading-base-id="tools" aria-label="Copy link to tools"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Tools</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>

<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">GPT-5.6 Terra is the mid-tier model in OpenAI&#x27;s GPT-5.6 family. It sits between Sol and Luna on intelligence and price, making it a strong pick for everyday agentic coding when you want more capability than Luna without Sol&#x27;s cost.</p>
